audit.whatIsWrong: Abilities were referred to by nicknames or the wrong slot: 'Boomerang (Q)' for Boomerang Throw, 'hyper hops' fusing Hyper (W) with Hop (E), and Common Mistakes blaming 'Mega-E' for the wall stun.
audit.why: Riot data: Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, W Hyper / Wallop, E Hop / Crunch, R GNAR!. The wall stun belongs to GNAR! (R), not to Mega E (Crunch), which is plain area damage. Telling a player to avoid walls because of Mega E points them at the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout; the wall stun re-attributed to GNAR! (R); Wallop named as Mega's stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] listed GNAR!'s cooldown as '(—)' and the whole page treated it as a normal tracked cooldown.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30s but is gated by the Rage bar — it is only castable in Mega form, so the Rage bar, not a timer, is the spike to read. Hop (E) at 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and Boomerang Throw at 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s (reduced when caught) are the real cooldowns in lane.
audit.corrected: Rage bar named as the spike, with GNAR!'s 90/60/30 and Hop's 22s written in.

audit.why: 51.93% over 3162 games. Gnar L1-L2, Garen L3-L5, Skill at 6 / first item / 2+ items matches TRICKY 5.5/10 and carry 7.5/10, and matches the packet chart. No mirror audit exists yet for gnar__garen.
Hop is 22s at rank 1 — with it down Mini Gnar has no escape from Garen's Q move-speed run-down.
audit.corrected: Hop's 22s added to dosFull[0] and spikes[0].

edits.before: Gnar Mini kite hop and Mega Gnar wall smash
edits.after: Hop (E) kiting and Mega Wallop (W) into GNAR!

edits.before: Track Gnar’s GNAR! (Mega Stun) (—): His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track his Rage bar, not a cooldown — GNAR! is 90/60/30s but only casts as Mega. Wallop (W) stuns; Hop (E) is 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: Fight Mega’s all-in. Get kited by his hop. Stand near walls for Mega-E. Save the R for moments with names on them.
edits.after: Fighting Mega's all-in. Getting kited by Hop (E). Standing near a wall — GNAR! stuns you into it. Saving R for kills.

edits.before: Track his Gnar Gnar Mini kite hop and Mega Gnar wall smash before you commit
edits.after: Track his Rage bar and his Hop (E), 22s at rank 1, before you commit

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: Mega form is the punish — step up while the Rage bar is low and Hop is down.

edits.before: Enemy misses or wastes Gnar Mini kite hop and Mega Gnar wall smash; Garen immediately Q sprints forward, silences them, executes a full Judgment spin loop to shred their armor, and drops Demacian Justice for an easy kill.
edits.after: He burns Hop (E) or drops out of Mega with a low Rage bar: Decisive Strike (Q) closes on the move-speed burst and silences Boomerang Throw, Judgment (E) spins him down, and Demacian Justice executes on missing health.

edits.before: Mini Gnar kites you at levels 1-2 with Boomerang (Q) and hops, but once you reach 3 you can walk him down with Q move-speed and spin E when he's stuck in melee.
edits.after: Mini Gnar kites you at 1-2 with Boomerang Throw (Q) — 16s at rank 1, less if he catches it — but from 3 you walk him down on Q move speed and spin E once Hop is gone.

edits.before: Kite with Boomerang Q and hyper hops in Mini form
edits.after: Kite with Boomerang Throw Q and Hop E in Mini form

notes: No mirror audit existed for gnar__garen, so this side is the first pass; the facts stated here (Gnar ahead L1-2, Garen ahead L3-5, Rage bar as the spike) should be restated inverted when that side is written. Whether Garen's Courage tenacity meaningfully shortens Wallop or the GNAR! wall stun is not answerable from the kit files and I did not assert it.
